items.title: A base change map in the flat case for ringed topoi

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma constructs a canonical base change map g^*Rf_*F^bullet -> R(f')_*(g')^*F^bullet for a commutative diagram of ringed topoi in which both g and g' are flat, F^bullet being a bounded below complex of modules (statement lines 2426-2450, with the Xy-pic diagram delivered verbatim). The proof resolves the complex by injectives so that the derived pushforward is computed explicitly (proof lines 2452-2462), uses flatness to compute the two pullbacks naively (proof lines 2462-2478), and compares the two composites to produce the map (proof lines 2478-2484). The non-formal content is the use of flatness to make the comparison naive. The claim is H2: one resolution choice plus one comparison.
